title: TARSTradingEvent
description: Canonical trading event contract shared by TARS backend, laptop UI, iPhone UI, ESP32 (future), and the quant_brain adapter (future). This is a companion/informational event, not a trade instruction. Do not add any AI confidence/probability field to this schema; see docs/coordination/DECISIONS.md ADR-004.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change and record a new ADR in DECISIONS.md.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this event was emitted.

source.description: Origin of the event. V1 uses 'mock' exclusively; 'quant_brain' is reserved for the future real integration; 'manual' is reserved for user/coordinator-authored test events.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol this event concerns, e.g. 'XAUUSD', 'ES'.

strategy_id.description: Identifier of the strategy that produced this event, if applicable. Null for system-level events (e.g. SYSTEM_WARNING).

direction.description: Directional bias of the setup, if any. Null/NONE for non-directional or system-level events.

risk_reward.description: Risk:reward ratio for the setup, if applicable.

risk_percent.description: Risk expressed as a percentage of account/reference size, if applicable. Informational only; TARS never sizes or places trades.

validation_status.description: Validation status of this event's underlying setup, distinct from lifecycle 'state'.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable codes explaining why this event/state was produced (e.g. why a setup was invalidated).

warnings.description: Human-readable warning strings associated with this event, e.g. risk or data-quality warnings.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this event/setup should be considered stale by consumers. Null if not applicable.
